note: Forest Preserve District of DuPage County campground in Blackwell Forest Preserve, Warrenville: two loops of gravel pads in the woods north of Silver Lake. Gates lock one hour after sunset. --Claude
summary: DuPage FPD camping page and 2024 map read; imagery checked. 64 sites (tents/trailers/motorhomes), electric only (amperage unstated), no water/sewer; shower house, flush toilets, water fill, dump. $25 resident / $40 non-resident (no resident-only restriction or window). Friday/Saturday nights only, May - Columbus Day weekend. ActiveNet booking (operator). Phone 630-933-7248 confirmed. Pin ~250 m west of the loops (entrance junction). Not waterfront kept.
flags: WEEKENDS ONLY: 'Sites are available Friday and Saturday nights May through Columbus Day weekend with added nights around the holidays.' Not a standing minimum and not a drop criterion, but the campground is unusable midweek; season.note says so. Reviewer may want to know.
RESIDENT RESTRICTION: none; price only ($25 DuPage resident / $40 non-resident). Permits online 24/7 for anyone.

ONE VEHICLE: 'You cannot have more than eight people, two tents and one vehicle at your site' (overflow parking not mentioned) - a motorhome with a towed car may need to ask Visitor Services. Not a criteria failure.
FIT: no site lengths published; the page names 'trailers, and motor homes' sites and the pads are gravel back-in spurs ~15 m+ on imagery. Keep.
PIN (~250 m, borderline): stored 41.83866,-88.17590 is the campground entrance junction off the preserve road; the loops' centre is about 41.8381,-88.1730. Optional move to 41.8381,-88.1730.
HOOKUPS: electric amperage is not published; nothing written for electric.
No horse area at this campground. Waterfront not waterfront kept (Silver Lake 100 m+ SW through woods).
